item.title: Extended Reality (XR) Environments: A Comprehensive Overview
item.description: Extended Reality (XR) is an umbrella term encompassing Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Mixed Reality (MR). These digital ecosystems redefine human-computer interaction by creating immersive and interactive experiences. Understanding XR Modalities XR environments integrate digital elements with the physical world to varying degrees: Virtual Reality (VR): Fully immerses users in a simulated digital space, blocking out the physical environment. Ideal for complete escapism and simulation. Augmented Reality (AR): Overlays digital information onto the real world, enhancing perception without replacing reality.
